Hi Maya — thanks for the PO and the details. I'm looping in Karthik (billing) and Grace (account lead) to scope the split and the credit.

Preliminary answers:
- Yes, we can emit separate invoice artifacts: one for EU VAT (reverse-charge vs. standard VAT will depend on the EU VAT ID you send) and one for UK VAT items. Both can reference a single PO number.
- Please send your EU VAT number and the UK VAT ref (if available). We will also need the billing address for both legal entities.
- For the 12 deprovisioned seats, we'll calculate pro-rated credit from the de-provision date through the end of the billing period and include the credit line on the final statement.

Proposed timeline:
1) You provide VAT IDs + billing addresses + preferred remittance account by EOD Wed (2 June)
2) We produce a draft split invoice and credit memo by Thu (3 June) for your review
3) Final invoice issued and sent to accounts payable by Fri (4 June)

I'm attaching a draft workbook with the consumption snapshot so you can confirm the deprovision dates.

—Jonas
